player_prompt.intro:
Ungumdlali {player_id} ku-**Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Thumela ukunyakaza kwakho njengoba **[macro  micro]** (izinombolo ezimbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = iphedi elincane ulidlala kuwo
• *micro* = isikwele esingaphakathi kwalelo phedi elincane
Isibonelo `[7 8]` ➜ beka isikhala sakho kwenye phedi elincane 7, isikwele 8, futhi
xhoma umgadli wakho ukuba adlale kwenye phedi elincane 8 ezayo.

Ungu `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukudlulisa kufanele kube ngesimo [macro micro] ngezinombolo u-0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Izinkomba kufanele kube phakathi kuka-0 no-8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ibhodi le-micro_board, umugqa, noma ikholomu ayikho ebangeni.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Umdlali kumelwe adlale ebhodini elincane elilandelayo.

game_action.played: Umdlali {player_id} wadlala ebhodini elincane {macro_idx}, esitokisini {micro_idx} (umugqa {row}, ikholomu {col}). Umdlali {opponent_id} manje kufanele adlale ku {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umdlali {player_id} uwina i-Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
